**DK27.4** is a medical diagnosis code representing a chronic or unspecified gastroduodenal ulcer with hemorrhage [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system, it serves as a critical data point for monitoring patient safety and treatment complications, specifically for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. 

The code is utilized by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) in the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) to calculate the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) [^src3]. Because patients with atrial fibrillation are frequently treated with anticoagulants, tracking severe bleeding events is a vital quality indicator for evaluating the safety and effectiveness of their care [^src2]. DK27.4 is one of several gastrointestinal bleeding codes—alongside others in the ranges DK25.0–DK29.8A and DK92.0–DK92.2—used to capture these adverse events in national registry analyses [^src1]. 

The definition and application of DK27.4 as a quality indicator have remained consistent across multiple annual iterations of the AFDK reports, appearing in the methodology sections of the 2023, 2024, and 2025 publications [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. This consistency underscores its role as a standardized metric for clinical quality measurement and cross-regional comparison in Danish cardiovascular care [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
